text: Give me an overview of how the flora (bushes, grass, trees) are made and rendered in cart/editor

events.text: Traced current active cart/editor flora end-to-end: cart-owned kind/lane/density tables, host-native RLE cell painting, deterministic foliage.zig expansion, WorldLoader geometry batches, slim GPU instance formats and grass/frond shaders. Also confirmed the current publish gap: editor compile is disabled and /play still mounts zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile.

resolution: Produced a source-backed overview of cart/editor flora from the authoring swatches and three RLE cell lanes through deterministic native population, procedural geometry, instanced GPU batches, wind/cutout shaders, persistence, and collision behavior. Also surfaced the current publishing boundary: live editor/playtest foliage works, but world compile remains disabled and /play still mounts the existing hmsc.gamefile. This was a read-only investigation; no code changed.
